question: Which mother goddesses are introduced in the northern direction after Bharaṇī?
premises: Bharaṇī is mentioned in relation to the north.
inference: In the northern context after Bharaṇī, Brāhmī and Māheśvarī are introduced.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of bharaṇyā to the rest of the verse is unclear.
plain_english: With Bharaṇī in the north, Brāhmī and then Māheśvarī are named.
